content.text: The redline validated. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: Searches for "insur" and "coverage" return no hits, and a full read of the General Provisions (Section 10, p0059-p0070) and the operative sections confirms the Agreement imposes no insurance obligation on either party. HDI is squarely a services/hosting vendor: it stores and operates the Site on its computer system (p0009), collects and exports customer order data (p0010), and has access to Company Content, user information and customer e-mail lists as Confidential Information (p0044, p0048). That places the document below even the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) and near walk-away territory for a vendor processing customer data. We therefore insert a new Section 10.9 at the preferred position (CGL USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request), placed in the miscellaneous section per the redline guidance. The comment offers the fallback limits as a negotiating position.

proposal.summary: Insert Section 10.9 requiring HDI to carry CGL, E&O, cyber and workers' compensation insurance with certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no insurance obligation, and HDI hosts the Site, processes customer orders and handles our confidential customer data. We have added a standard insurance provision (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request); if helpful, we can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M as a fallback.

ops.text: 10.9 Insurance. HDI shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for a period of one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than One Million Dollars ($1,000,000) per occurrence and Two Million Dollars ($2,000,000) in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than Two Million Dollars ($2,000,000); (c) cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than Five Million Dollars ($5,000,000) covering HDI's hosting of the Site and its processing of Confidential Information and customer data; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. HDI shall provide the Company with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
